description:
We are a team of three passionate high school students from Mississauga, Canada, with strong interests in computer science, mathematics, physics, robotics, and space exploration.

John has experience in Python, Java, and Luau programming, along with robotics and collaborative coding projects. Zayaan brings strong knowledge of physics and analytical problem-solving, while Hieu has excellent skills in mathematics and physics, as well as broad knowledge of astronomy and space science.
summary: Our project is an interactive 3D space simulation built using Python and the Ursina game engine. It aims to use physics concepts such as gravity, motion, and planetary movement through visual representations of objects in space. By using code to develop our imaginative ideas, we hope to create an engaging educational experience that makes complex scientific concepts easier to understand.
details: Our project is an interactive 3D space simulation developed using Python and the Ursina game engine. It aims to model objects in space, such as planets, and demonstrate how their movements and interactions are influenced. The project can help users better understand concepts such as gravity, motion, and planetary behavior through a visual and interactive experience. We used Python, VS Code, and Ursina to develop the simulation, along with 3D modelling techniques to create celestial objects. Our project is creative because it combines programming, physics, and 3D visualization to make complex scientific concepts easier to understand. During development, we considered scientific accuracy, realistic object movement, visual design, and making the simulation engaging and accessible to users.
